card.name: Start of words beginning with En
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word starting with "En" or "en" (Enasidenib, Encephalopathy, Engraftment, Ensitrelvir, Enbrel) right after a section number or sentence break. Also the digit 1 in "C1" or "C-1".

modes.label: En- word starts
modes.description: "En" opens a drug or condition name at the start of a sentence or heading.

modes.label: Digit 1 in chemical or protein names
modes.description: The number 1 after C or C- in names like C1 esterase inhibitor.
modes.example: C<<1>> esterase inhibitor preparations, including anaph
